text: Kingsmoor FC methodically advance the ball from their own half on the left side, completing multiple short passes over nearly a minute. The ball reaches Viktor Quinlan near the right flank in the attacking third. Quinlan quickly lays it off with a short pass to Felix Duarte, positioned just outside the six-metre box in front of Westport Albion’s goal. Duarte takes a close-range shot with his foot, but it goes off target, missing a significant chance to score. The score remains tied at 2-2. [#695] [#709] [#710] [#713]
